---
title: "Rides dashboard"
---

Starting point for the agentic SDLC lab. Daily ride counts for three cities,
July to September 2026, loaded from `data/rides.csv` by tested functions in
`R/stats.R`.

```{r}
source("R/stats.R")
df <- load_rides()
cat("Total rides:", format(total_rides(df), big.mark = ","), "\n")
knitr::kable(rides_by_city(df), col.names = c("City", "Rides"))
```

## Rides by city

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Total rides per city, July to September 2026"
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(rides_by_city(df), aes(x = city, y = rides)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#028090") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Rides") +
  theme_minimal()
```
